patterns.note: Asymmetrical content blocks are used to balance text and imagery or card groups, creating dynamic visual interest without strict mirroring.
Extremely large, wide, and bold sans-serif display typography is used for hero and key section headlines, creating significant visual impact.
High contrast is maintained between a very light, almost off-white background and dark text, punctuated by a vibrant red accent for CTAs and branding.
The primary navigation bar transforms from a transparent, full-size state to a smaller, sticky version with a solid light background as the user scrolls past the hero section.
Content sections and individual elements within them are revealed with a subtle slide-up and fade-in animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
Full-bleed, distinct sections with generous vertical padding are used, often featuring a single dominant visual or headline to clearly delineate content areas.

technique_notes: The motion system uses a scroll-triggered animation library (like GSAP ScrollTrigger) to reveal content sections and individual elements with a staggered slide-up and fade-in effect as they enter the viewport. The sticky navigation also uses a scroll listener to trigger a size and background color transformation.
Typography is designed with a display-heavy sans-serif font for maximum impact on hero and section headlines, creating a dramatic size contrast with the more legible body text.

The color palette relies on a minimalist base of a very light background and dark text, with a single, high-impact accent color (red) strategically applied to branding, calls to action, and full-bleed sections like the footer.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold display headings (~5-6x body text) with smaller, legible body text and even smaller uppercase labels, creating a strong visual hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on cards and interactive elements, with generally sharp edges for main section containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, especially in the hero section and between major content blocks, with balanced density within feature grids and text columns.

standout: The site's distinctive use of extremely large, wide, and bold sans-serif typography for key headlines, combined with a high-contrast, minimalist color palette punctuated by a vibrant red accent, creates a confident and modern aesthetic that feels both impactful and refined.
